annotation.evidence_span: prior to the reception of the unidirectional stream header
annotation.interpretation_a: The receiver must tolerate a close/reset signal *before* any data from the stream is received, even before the header.
annotation.interpretation_b: The receiver must tolerate a close/reset signal before receiving the header, but it is permissible for the receiver to have already received some initial data (e.g. 1-byte) before the header.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'prior to' can be interpreted in two ways: strictly before any data is received, or before the header is received, even if some initial data has been received. This affects how the receiver must handle the close/reset signal.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear if any data can be received before the header. The phrase 'prior to' is ambiguous in this context.
